question: Why does someone behind the reflecting space fail to hear the echo?
premises: One standing behind a mirror does not see the reflected face.
An echo follows the same reflective orientation as a visual image.
One standing behind the reflecting acoustic space is not in the proper orientation.
inference: A person behind the reflecting space does not hear the echo, just as one behind a mirror does not see the reflection.
plain_english: Just as someone standing behind a mirror does not see the face, someone standing behind the reflecting space does not hear the echo.
